quotes.text: When any policy issue comes to me, I'm going to ask: what would the founders say? What we need to do is get back to what this country was founded on — individual liberty, states' rights, all the things that are defined in the Bill of Rights, in the Constitution, and the Declaration of Independence.
quotes.editor_note: Verbatim from KCTV5's 'Kansas Governor Candidate Guide' — an on-record video Q&A KCTV5 ran with all 10 candidates, published as a written transcript without per-clip timestamps (tier 2, news interview). Answering the affordability/first-year-priority question, states his governing framework (test every policy against founding constitutional principles) rather than a specific tax mechanism — the most distinct approach among the field on this question, though thinner on concrete mechanism than the debate participants' answers. No Compass stance on file yet for this new candidate.

quotes.text: I'm not a fan of any quasi-governmental operation. The state shouldn't be in the business of capitalism or any type of business, as far as that goes. … Just on principle, I'm not a fan.
quotes.editor_note: Verbatim from the same KCTV5 candidate-guide series, a separate on-record segment on the Chiefs/STAR-bonds deal (… cuts a reference to state-owned gambling, kept out as a second example of the same principle). States a clear anti-subsidy, free-market position on state-backed development deals — a sharp contrast with Masterson/Schwab's pro-incentive framing on the same question. No Compass stance on file yet for this new candidate.
